INSERT INTO oauth_refresh_tokens (token_id, client_id, user_id, scope, expires_at, created_at, family_id, resource)
                     SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $1, $7
                     FROM oauth_auth_codes
                     WHERE code = $8 AND refresh_token_id = $1
                     FOR UPDATE
